profiles.role: Caster skill and survival armor alternative
conditions: Source-specific player body-armor alternative; preserve equipment requirements and the rest of the casting/resistance setup. A legal upgraded base is not automatically a better roll. No unspecified socket filler or full-loadout breakpoint is inferred.

Fire and cold skill damage are credited only to the corresponding spells; lightning damage is not a priority for these builds. Native random +3 Sorceress skill rolls use IDs36–60: Fire Wall51 and Meteor56 are possible, Hydra62 and Frozen Orb64 are not. A matching random skill is optional, not assumed or required; other skill rolls are not promoted. FCR does not remove casting delays.
